sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, as long-term partnerships are the foundation of our mutual success.
In recognition of the extended contract term, we are prepared to revise our offer to €51.30 per unit.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a genuine pleasure to work alongside Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Over our 12-year relationship, our family foundry has taken immense pride in delivering the highest craftsmanship to support your production, and we deeply value the trust we have built together over all these years.

Regarding our current negotiations, our offer stands at a price of €50.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Therefore, 50.20 EUR per unit is our final offer. We deeply value our 12-year relationship and trust you will understand that we cannot concede further. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We hope these terms allow us to continue our long-standing partnership, and we look forward to hearing your decision.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
